_comment: The node-tier ladder's contract, shared by every implementation of it.
The rules live in three places that cannot see each other at build time:
gateway-rust/src/node_tier.rs (the canonical statement, and the only one
that runs continuously), and noo-cli's two birth-time parsers in
commands/provision.rs — derive_tier_facts over the enrolment JSON and
derive_tier over `noo-gate facts` text. There is no shared crate: the two
Cargo projects have no workspace, no path dependency and separate Docker
build contexts, so a compiler cannot hold them together.
This file can. Both crates' unit tests read it and assert every case,
and tests/test_node_tier_ladder_parity.py fails if either stops reading
it. Add a case here first; a rule that only one side implements shows up
as a red test rather than as a mis-tiered node.
`tier: null` means the ladder must DECLINE — the facts do not decide.
Only the gateway distinguishes this: the CLI ladders run at birth where
the enrolling script always sends every field, so they resolve their
absences to the worker default. Cases marked birth_time_default say what
the CLI is allowed to answer instead.

cases.name: workstation with a discrete GPU
cases.why: tier 1 is controller-class and never auto-assigned from a GPU-present signal

cases.name: jetson reports VRAM but is edge
cases.why: the board branch runs before the GPU rules; a VRAM-first ladder gives a Jetson vLLM work

cases.name: raspberry pi 5
cases.why: no GPU, but edge rather than CPU worker

cases.name: arm server with no board model
cases.why: aarch64 with nothing else to go on is edge by architecture

cases.name: 8GB mac mini
cases.why: unified memory is a real GPU; 8 GB of it landed in tier 4 before this branch existed

cases.name: large mac studio stays tier 2
cases.why: no vLLM on Metal, so no amount of unified memory earns the second slot

cases.name: cuda unified memory box reaches tier 1
cases.why: DGX Spark / GB10 class — CUDA, so vLLM runs

cases.name: tiny unified memory box is edge
nothing reported
cases.why: on the heartbeat path silence is not evidence; deriving 3 here and comparing it against a declared 1 manufactures a disagreement out of an older agent build

cases.name: unified memory with no usable figure
cases.why: the branch exists to weigh the usable share; without it there is nothing to weigh
